rationale: The four positive-residual rows (targets 0.66-0.84) all have x2*x5 > 0 (about 1.09, 1.13, 0.83, 0.54) and |x4| of at least 1.0 (-1.004, 1.385, -1.564, -1.975). The six negative-residual rows (targets 0.21-0.56) all have x2*x5 < 0 (about -0.7 to -3.3) and |x4| of at most 0.55.
